en: A sepia-toned panoramic view over a small riverside town with a mix of wooden houses in the foreground and a larger, more monumental masonry building at the center. Beyond it stretches a broad river or lake with wooded hills on both banks and scattered industrial buildings and piers along the shoreline. At the very bottom edge of the image, partially cut off, is the caption text naming the location.
